description: Joint Research Centre: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Joint Research Centre, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Joint Research Centre. Coverage: Joint Research Centre. The listing groups 220 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Electricity Mix; AC; consumption mix, at consumer; 230V (Location: RO); Electricity grid mix; AC; consumption mix, at consumer; 230V (Location; Electricity Mix; AC; consumption mix, at consumer; 1kV - 60kV (Locatio; Electricity grid mix 1kV-60kV; AC; consumption mix, at consumer; 1kV -. Formats seen: ZIP, TIFF, XLS, CSV, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://eplca.jrc.ec.europa.eu/ELCD3/templates/default/html/datasetLicense.html), European Commission reuse notice, CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-jrc.
